name: SendGrid Email Pattern
explanation:
Pattern for sending emails via SendGrid.

Key settings:
- toEmail: Recipient email address
- fromEmail: Sender email (must be verified in SendGrid)
- fromName: Sender display name
- subject: Email subject line
- bodyTemplate: Email body (supports {{context.xxx}} variables)

Template variables:
- {{message}}: User input message
- {{aiResponse}}: AI response text
- {{context.aiResponse}}: Same as above
- {{jsonData.fieldName}}: JSON output field

Setup required:
1. Configure SendGrid API key in Connections
2. Verify sender email in SendGrid

Result stored in context.sendGridResult.
